title: Every owner's secrets now sit under a key of their own
promise: The vault looks the same, but each owner's secrets are sealed with their own key and bound to the row they live in.

scenes.title: A secret goes in the way it always did
scenes.proves: Nothing changed for the owner; the value is sealed with her own key on save.
scenes.watch: Her first secret is what mints her key. No setup, no new screen.

scenes.title: Only names in the list, the value on demand
scenes.proves: Lists never carry a value; a reveal opens it for 60 seconds and logs it.
scenes.watch: The row shows a name only; the value comes from a separate, logged request.

scenes.title: Her son sees what she chose to share
scenes.proves: The double filter still holds with per-owner keys.
scenes.watch: Same rules as yesterday. The key change is invisible to the contact too.

scenes.title: A value moved to another row does not open
scenes.proves: Each value is bound to its row and column; another row or owner's key cannot open it.
scenes.watch: The seed copied the Wi-Fi's sealed value onto the Old router row in the database. Before 11-24 a copied value would have opened.

scenes.title: Older secrets moved over on their own
scenes.proves: At boot the API reseals values from the app-wide key onto the owner's key.
scenes.watch: Netflix was written before the change. Nobody re-entered it.
